messages.author: 32718bb33d21258b
messages.subject: GPU
parts:
Hello,

Do you know if the GenomicSEM package on R is GPU enabled? I am trying to run common factor gwas on 40 traits, which requires a lot of memory and run time. I was informed that if this program is GPU enabled, it may be able to run faster, so I was wondering if it is. 

Thank you,
Rama

messages.author: 3b39745f73eec779
messages.subject: Re: GPU
parts:
Hi Rama,


unfortunately, it is not, though we are looking at GPU compute, its not something I expect to be a reality soon. There are various optimizations possible for GenomicSEM on Linux see this document for tips: https://github.com/GenomicSEM/GenomicSEM/wiki/1.1-For-Linux-users


Best,
Michel
